## Known gaps

This corpus is INCOMPLETE for navigation; an agent should not assume full coverage:

- 0 orphan document(s) (nothing links to them)
- 0 unreachable document(s) (not reachable from a root)
- 0 under-linked document(s) (few inbound links; hard to discover)
- 0 dead-end document(s) (no onward links)
- 0 broken link(s)
- 0 broken anchor(s)
- 0 ambiguous link(s)
- 1000 suggested link(s) (unlinked but topologically related; experimental)
